verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the platform is fully API-driven and explicitly supports creating 'tens, hundreds, or even thousands' of inboxes on demand, implying agents can script bulk creation, but there's no documented dedicated bulk/batch endpoint for messages, threads, or other items (e.g., bulk send, bulk label, bulk delete). Missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk API endpoints for messages/threads, documented rate-limit or batching guidance, hands-on evidence of bulk operations at scale.
